testContract: Every pixel in the entire 80 by 14-pixel slab band is opaque in every frame.
Every structural pixel outside the sink basin's declared central occlusion equals the canonical Option-B RGBA pixel exactly.
Kettle, toaster and mixer have no allowed countertop occlusion: their complete slab bands equal the canonical template exactly.
Kitchen V10 is a required failing control, proving the verifier detects colour and outline overwrites that an alpha-only test misses.
The test runs from npm test and covers standard, on and broken states frame by frame.
